stops.detail: Nestled in the Salzburg limestone high Alps, the Weissbach Nature Park and the Berchtesgaden National Park form a common natural space that bears witness to a lived border culture. In the nature park area of the mountaineering village of Weißbach, all visitors come to their expense: women with different alpinistic interests.
